thread:
maria: Heads-up — during the midnight pager I tried to export a trace for the Postgres timeout incident and hit a few usability issues. The export button only captured the currently visible spans (not the full trace), the correlation-id copy is hard to find, and keyboard focus jumps when the modal opens. cost me ~7 minutes to get a sharable artifact :grimacing:
jen: Ugh. Can you paste the exact steps you took? Is this the new 'Export snapshot' in trace viewer or the older download flow?
maria: It was the big kebab menu -> Export snapshot. I expected a dialog with a "Full trace" vs "Visible window" option. Instead it defaulted to visible, and the modal closed when I hit ESC then reopened weirdly.
alan: Thanks for reporting. A few quick ideas: 1) make "Full trace (recommended)" the default, 2) add a single-line place to surface the correlation id at top of modal (copy button right next to it), 3) ensure modal has role=dialog and focus goes to first actionable item.
sara: Adding product context — customers often export during incidents to attach to tickets. If default is "Visible window" we risk partial artifacts. We should also add a lightweight telemetry event: `trace_export.choice` with values {full,visible,range} so we can see defaults in practice.
sam: Temporary ops hack: right-click a span -> "Copy trace id" until this is fixed. Also: for oncall flow it would be nice if export generated a short permalink and auto-copied it to clipboard. Saves pasting into PagerDuty.
jen: Notes from runtime side: export currently streams visible spans because that's cheap memory-wise. Full trace export triggers a backend traversal which can be heavy on very long traces. We can implement a server-side pagination job and return a single downloadable archive — but need product acceptance for the UX tradeoff.
alan: Accessibility nits: the copy-corrid button has no aria-label; screen reader reads "button" only. Also color contrast for the modal CTA is borderline at 3.5:1 on some monitors. I can drop a quick mock with updated hierarchy and a single primary CTA and a secondary radio for 'Visible range'.
maria: That mock + making default full would have prevented my midnight fumbling. Also would love an option "Attach trace + metadata" that includes tags (service, env, commit) so we don't have to paste metadata separately.
sara: Agree. Let's scope: short-term (1) change default to Full trace + add copy corr id visible in modal (2) add telemetry for choice (3) UX tweak: focus trap and aria labels. Long-term: server-side paginated export + attach metadata bundle.
jen: I'll open a runtime ticket for paginated export and add a feature flag so we can roll out. For short-term I'll add an API param `?full=true` and wire the UI radio.
ops-bot: Reminder: Scheduled deploy window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. If we want the short-term UI change in today's deploy, please tag the PR with `release/trace-export` and add `deploy:urgent` label.
sam: small ask — can we have the modal show an estimated size and warn if full trace >50MB? Avoids failed uploads to PD attachments.
alan: Will include size estimate in mock. Also propose a visible helper text: "Full trace may take longer to generate; use Visible window for quick excerpts."
maria: Thanks all — filing a short incident retrospective with the timeline. @jen please ping when you have the runtime ticket number so I can link it. :thumbsup:
jen: will do, will reference #inc-2023-482 and attach initial runtime perf numbers.
ops-bot: Deploy note logged: PR #4802 tagged release/trace-export (no `deploy:urgent` label yet).
